project.name: Pronto inventory and routing
project.identity: The Pronto portfolio and routing surface for local repository truth.
project.audience: Operators and agents coordinating a repository fleet without losing workspace state.
project.core_loop: Read live repository evidence, classify the current state, project a safe next action, and preserve the handoff.
project.north_star: A fleet operator can see what is true locally and what action is safe without turning stale projection into authority.
not_this: Treating stale provider state as live Git truth
Owning every quality or release contract

scope.purpose: Maintain a durable local view of repositories and workspaces and explain the next safe action from current evidence.
scope.boundary: Owns portfolio inventory, workspace identity, route and next-action projections, and their renderer and CLI presentation; quality findings and release/provider adapters remain outside this child.
non_goals: Treating stale provider state as live Git truth
Owning every quality or release contract

mvp.definition: The scoped boundary is explicitly ratified, its parent outcome is clear, and its smallest local proof is repeatable.

complete_product.definition: The scoped boundary remains aligned through changes, interfaces, and user-visible or consumer-facing verification.

outcomes.name: The Pronto inventory and routing boundary advances its parent outcome without silently taking on sibling responsibilities.

layers.intended: Owner ratified this subsystem organization and its documented preservation obligations on 2026-09-11. Path assignments and current proof remain under review.
layers.planned: Complete source ownership, canonical behavior links, neighboring handoffs and repeatable scoped proof.
layers.implemented: Source-association review maps the exact owned paths in development.json; shared dispatch, models and transport remain explicit dependencies. This is observed structure, not a maturity upgrade.
layers.verified: Current proof is evaluated from workspace-bound receipts in development.json. Historical evidence and declared maturity do not establish current verification.
